## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature being requested.

## Problem Solved
A clear description of what problem this feature solves for rural entrepreneurs or developers.

## Proposed Solution
Describe your proposed technical or functional solution.

## Expected Benefit
Explain how this feature improves platform utility, accuracy, performance, or user experience.

## Priority
- [ ] High (Critical for SIH submission / core MVP)
- [ ] Medium (Important feature, scheduled post-MVP)
- [ ] Low (Nice to have / future optimization)
